summary.name: OverSight
summary.one_liner: OverSight is a free, open-source macOS tool that monitors the microphone and webcam and alerts the user whenever either is activated.
use_cases: Get alerted when an app turns on the Mac's webcam or microphone
Detect malware secretly recording audio or video
Allow or block specific apps from using the camera or mic
Trigger an 'on air' light or script when the mic is active
Monitor secondary processes piggybacking on video call sessions
summary.what_it_does: OverSight runs in the background on macOS and alerts the user whenever the microphone is activated or the webcam is accessed, including when the system is already infected. When a device is activated, it shows a notification naming the device and the process responsible, where possible. From the alert, the user can allow a process once, always allow it, or terminate it. It can also detect secondary processes that piggyback on an existing webcam session. An optional Action tab runs a user-specified script or binary on mic or camera events.
notable: Identifies the process accessing the webcam or mic and offers allow or block options
Detects secondary processes piggybacking on existing webcam sessions
Can run a user script or binary on mic/camera events
Free and open-source, distributed by Objective-See
caveats: Requires macOS 12+ for the current version 2.4.0; older macOS versions need older releases that are not officially supported
Must be installed and run from an administrative account
Process identification is not always possible; a generic alert is then shown without allow/block options
Notifications are suppressed when macOS Do Not Disturb is enabled
